name: MathMist
description: MathMist is a parallel multilingual benchmark dataset for mathematical problem solving and reasoning, containing over 21,000 aligned question-answer pairs across seven languages. It evaluates LLMs' mathematical competence in diverse linguistic settings, including low-resource languages, under various reasoning paradigms such as zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and code-switched reasoning.
reputation: A newly introduced multilingual math benchmark that is too recent to have broad community adoption yet.
notes: Covers high-, medium-, and low-resource languages; highlights LLMs' deficiencies in multilingual mathematical reasoning.
